lines.text: Let'sTalk
The Covid-19 pandemic hit the world really hard. A number of safety measures were
adopted to reduce the spread of the virus. In pairs, discuss the safety procedures adopted
during the pandemic.For example, you can talk about why people were asked to wear masks
or,howtheuse ofmasks can reduce the spreadof the disease.
Remember to discuss the latest facts. If possible, take help from the internet to gather
information.
